hypothesis_summary.name: Foreign Flow Residualized on Individual Flow (Diversifier)
hypothesis_summary.mechanism: 각 종목 t월 말: (1) 지난 21일 외국인 net buy cross-sectional z-score → z_F. (2) 지난 21일 개인 net buy cross-sectional z-score → z_I. (3) Expanding-window pooled OLS β_t (burn-in 60m, C1 strict lag 1m). (4) residual_t = z_F_t - β_t × z_I_t. (5) residual Top 20 EW Long, t+1 실행.
hypothesis_summary.why_now: PG0 Sharpe gap 0.807 잔여. Governor 2-defense ensemble 최적 조합도 SR 1.30~1.45 → 독립 alpha 추가 확보 필수. H_1674 corr 0.897 결함 v2 residualization으로 해소 (실측 mean |corr| 0.194, channel preservation 0.895).
hypothesis_summary.core_reference: Choe-Kho-Stulz 2005 RFS 'Do Domestic Investors Have an Edge?' + 고영훈·안일찬 2018 한국재무학회지 '거래주체별 누적순매수와 주가수익률'. Residualization: Fama-MacBeth (1973) orthogonalization standard.

signal_construction.z_F: cross-sectional z-score of frollsum(Foreign, n=21, align='right') at month-end t, winsorize 1/99
signal_construction.z_I: cross-sectional z-score of frollsum(Individual, n=21, align='right') at month-end t, winsorize 1/99
signal_construction.beta_t: expanding-window pooled no-intercept OLS β_t = shift(Σ_{s≤t-1} Σ_i z_F_{s,i}·z_I_{s,i} / Σ_{s≤t-1} Σ_i z_I_{s,i}², 1L). burn-in 60 months.
signal_construction.sensitivity_note: C4 조건 — 21d baseline + 63d + 126d 3종 병렬 실행 (VERDICT conditions_for_s1 [4]). 회전율/ICIR/SR 전수 보고.
signal_construction.z_score_method: Z_Score_Aligned (C13 준수). 잔차 자체가 최종 signal — 별도 z-score 미적용 (Fama-MacBeth 관행).
